DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-0: Wow! What beautiful feathers! Are you another scholar panning for gold in all this historical rubbish?!
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-1: A scholar? Heh. I prefer... a curious witness. Does this junk of yours really hold the secrets of the ancients?
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-2: Junk?! These are one-of-a-kind treasures! Pick one, feather lady. It might keep you alive a little longer in the tower!
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.1-0: You again! What scraps of the old world are you after this time? I saved you something with peculiar markings!
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-0: Darv, some of the structures in your collection of wreckage seem to match the Architect's early blueprints remarkably well.
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-1: Hey! Stop looking at me like you're interrogating a criminal! These are harmless collectibles, not deadly state secrets!
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-2: Relax, darling. I have no interest in your little life... But tell me a little more about where this came from, and I may graciously take the relic off your hands.
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-3: Take it, take it! A serpent's tongue is trickier than a trap! Off you go. Let me count my stock!
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.3-0: That staff of yours... the storm in it makes every bone in my body shake!
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.3-1: Oh, just a few trifling gifts from my ancestors. Tell me, is there a vessel in all that scrap of yours that can withstand a storm like this?
DARV.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.3-2: Enough wind! Enough! What if you blow all my treasures away?! Take this and get going!
NEOW.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-0: A great beast that has awakened the dead countless times... Deep in your memory, is there also a record of the moment civilization first broke apart?
NEOW.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-1:
[sine]...feathered serpent... bearing... an ancient... bloodline...
...the answers... you crave... await... at the summit...
...kill... the... [red][jitter]Architect[/jitter][/red]...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.1-0: [sine]...once again... you awaken... upon the wind...?[/sine]
NEOW.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-0:
[sine]...you hide... your fear... behind lies... and mockery...
...but... oblivion... is devouring... your... past...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-1: There is no need to mourn on my behalf. Rather than wallow in the past, I prefer the pleasure of tearing the truth from its shrine with my own hands.
NEOW.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-2:
[sine]...then go... let your... obsession...
...shatter... his... cage...[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MO: My, what a breathtaking figure! Those splendid feathers, that exquisite form... You are a beauty beyond all other climbers. Come here, lovely lady. Let me add a little luster to your grace.
Miss Feathered Serpent, even the cycle has not dimmed your beauty. Here, take a gift worthy of it.
The Architect fancies himself an all-knowing master craftsman, yet everything he makes is utterly lifeless. How distasteful.
Precisely! Crude, rigid, and entirely without beauty! Go, tear his ugly gears apart with your storms.
Your eyes always hide so many calculations. You can hardly dance lightly with so many schemes weighing on your mind.
Without constant vigilance, I would have ended up on someone's dinner plate long ago. Survival has little use for innocent composure, Nonupeipe.
What an endearingly wary creature. Then may my blessing become the most obedient current beneath your wings.
OROBAS.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0: Wings! Big tail! A snake with wings?! Can you fly? Can you bite?! Don't eat Orobas!!
Easy, little one. I have little appetite for shriveled iridescence... Those ancient lights of yours, though, would make a fascinating study.
Not eating me?! Wonderful! Here, something shiny! Don't eat me! Eat this!!
OROBAS.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.1: The feather snake is slithering back! No big open mouth! Wonderful! Take this!
OROBAS.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2:
Past? Future? Can't remember! Head hurts!!
The Architect knows everything! The Architect is clever!!
He certainly believes he knows everything... So, has he ever told you the secret of the origin, my lovely little rainbow?
Don't know! Secrets bite! Orobas hates secrets! Have a shiny stone! Go find him at the top!!
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-0: [thinky_dots]Such an ancient presence... Are you searching for lost time? Take a piece of my flesh. It will bear your pain...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-1: Living tissue that endlessly multiplies and melts... What an intriguing specimen. Still, are you certain swallowing it has no side effects?
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-2: [thinky_dots]Only peace... endless dreams and peace... Hah...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.1-0: [thinky_dots]The sound of scales brushing the ground... You have returned. If it is power you crave, take it yourself...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-0: Dragon, you call that madman at the summit your father... Then how much do you know of his methods for tampering with the cores of his creations?
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-1: [thinky_dots]All I know... is that he made me... and then forgot me here... Such a weight...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-2: An abandoned creation... What a pitiable story. Rest assured, I will find him and settle that account on your behalf.
PAEL.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-3: [thinky_dots]Go... take me with you... Let him... sleep as well...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-0: [b]Cunning snake! Where is your weapon?! How do you smash bones with a staff?![/b]
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-1: Such crude barbarity. There are many ways to tear an enemy apart. Arts and tactics are usually far more elegant than blunt instruments.
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-2: [b]Nonsense! Muscle and steel are strength!! Take this blade and cut them down!![/b]
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.1-0: [b]You with the wings! Put aside that soft little magic and choose a real weapon!![/b]
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-0: [b]Feathered serpent, fight me!! Show me your fangs!![/b]
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-1: [i][font_size=22]Tanx roars and lunges through the storm, only to strike empty air.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-2: [b][jitter][font_size=22]Where are you hiding?!![/font_size][/jitter] Cough, cough! Nothing but wind! I cannot touch you!![/b]
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-3: Oh dear, losing your footing already? Before a true current, brute force is as clumsy as a moth flying into a flame.
TANX.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-4: [b]What strange techniques!! Not direct enough, but powerful all the same!! This weapon is yours!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MO: Well, well, look who it is! A charming lady from far away! Come warm yourself. Tezcatara has just baked some [jitter][b]piping-hot[/b][/jitter] treats. You need a full stomach for all that scheming!
Flames that see into people's hearts? Hehe. Your warmth really is a little overwhelming.
Don't be shy, little darling! Toss those cold secrets into the hearth for a [jitter][b]good roasting[/b][/jitter]. You'll feel better!
Welcome back, beautiful feathered serpent! Found anything to set those lovely eyes [jitter][b]ablaze[/b][/jitter] today?
Darling, you've been searching the tower for a lost past, haven't you? That old Architect has [jitter][b]buried all the best things beneath the firewood[/b][/jitter].
Indeed. And I would happily borrow a spark of yours to burn his treasury and his arrogant facade to ashes together.
Oh, just what I like to hear! Go on, set the summit [jitter][b]glowing red[/b][/jitter]. I'll keep your tea warm!
VAKUU.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.0-: Feathered serpent, bearer of a forgotten people's curse... Care to examine my contract? I could grant your fading bloodline true [sine]eternity[/sine].
Parading a contract before an agent versed in clauses and lies? Those nooses woven from hidden costs are far more obvious than you imagine.
Vigilance is a virtue... But when despair comes, you will need [sine]a devil's ink[/sine] after all.
VAKUU.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.1-: Clever serpent, always gathering power. Sign your name, and every secret of this tower will be yours to [sine]peruse[/sine].
VAKUU.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_MOD.2-: Do you think yourself the player who commands the board? Like the rest of those mortals, you are merely a [sine]specimen[/sine] struggling within the cycle.
At least I know which square I occupy. You can only sit here peddling cheap contracts. Which of us is more pitiable, Vakuu?
...A sharp-tongued little upstart. I hope you can still smile when the Architect crushes your wings.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYA: I have heard so much about you, Creator of the Spire. This tower's intricate construction is truly remarkable. Might you share the blueprints behind it?
A self-important reptile. My magnificent creations are not research material for petty thieves like you.
If you refuse to be generous, I shall simply have to take them home my own way... along with you.
Insolence. Become rubble beneath the bricks of my tower.
I am back, Architect. As long as you harbor history yet to be unraveled, the storm will never cease.
Why are the vermin Neow sends always so noisy?
Vermin? When that shrine you are so proud of collapses, don't beg me to record your elegy.
This entire tower moves in perfect accordance with my will. Mortal struggles are meaningless.
Perfect accordance? All I see is fear, stagnation, and a coward locked at the summit, too afraid to face the end!
